name: Realistic Lighting for Tarkov
teaser: Enhance your game with a ReShade preset and Amands Graphics that brightens nights and balances visuals across all maps and times. With stunning new levels of contrast, the world is now clearer and more vibrant, bringing your virtual environment to life.
description_html:
Immerse yourself in a breathtaking visual journey with a masterful fusion of Amands Graphics and ReShade. Experience a dramatic leap in visual fidelity as colors become richer, fuller, and more alive than ever before. Every landscape, from lush forests to urban wastelands, bursts with newfound vibrancy.

Key Features:

  • Vibrant, Saturated Colors: Say goodbye to washed-out visuals. Every hue is meticulously enhanced, creating a stunning and immersive palette that makes the game feel truly new.
  • Abolished Nighttime Grayscale: The dreary, monotonous grayscale of the night is banished. Navigate moonlit landscapes with stunning clarity and rich, authentic tones.
  • Dramatic Sunsets: Witness awe-inspiring sunsets that paint the sky in spectacular, fiery oranges and deep purples, creating moments of cinematic beauty.
  • Challenging Stormy Weathers: While nights are brighter, stormy weather remains a true test of skill, with a dark, moody, and intense atmosphere.
  • Reduced Fog: Both interior and exterior fog are significantly reduced, revealing breathtaking vistas and crisp, clear lines of sight across all maps.
  • Next to No FPS Loss: Crafted with performance in mind, this preset delivers a visual feast with minimal impact on your frame rate, allowing you to enjoy the beauty without compromise.

Unleash the full potential of your game’s graphics and see every detail with unparalleled clarity. This is the definitive visual experience you’ve been waiting for.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Installation Instructions

(do not try to use this online)

Requires Reshade 6.3.1 and Amands Graphics.

1. Drop the file called Tarkov 2025 into your SPT folder (the folder with the games exe in it.)

2. Install Amands Graphics.

3. Install Reshade 6.3.1 When installing reshade, please select Tarkov 2025 for your preset. After selecting this and clicking next, your computer will download all required shaders and the parameters will be set.

4. In the download there is a folder called BepinEx. it has the config file for Amands Graphics. Please install this LAST. If you dont, your game wont look like my screenshots.

5. Play game.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When installing Reshade select your eft.exe in your SPT folder and press next, then select Directx 10/11/12 on the next screen, press next. On the Select preset to install screen, the file called Tarkov 2025should auto-populate in the bottom text field if you followed step 1. If it doesn’t, browse to your SPT folder and select it.

Click next on the select effects screen once the preset ‘Tarkov 2025’ is loaded.

Then click finish once its done doing its thing.
